recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man in western attire against a dramatic sunset horizon, featuring high-contrast vintage-style typography that overlaps the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a horizontal horizon line
Warm golden hour lighting reflecting off suede and denim textures
Bold, blocky sans-serif paired with fluid, retro script lettering
Dark foreground silhouette transitioning to a vibrant orange and brown sky
coreInvariants: Heavy drop shadows on text for depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three-quarter length portrait, centered, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face looking off-camera and the large central text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the jacket, then across the large horizontal text, ending at the belt buckle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of dark foreground at the bottom and expansive sky at the top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans (suede jacket, hat, sky gradient).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues (jeans and foreground shadow).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow (horizon glow and text fill).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the horizon line; low value in the bottom third; medium value on the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and sunset hues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy condensed sans-serif and a 1970s-style brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: Thick strokes, tight tracking, slight vertical stretch.
Script: High-contrast thick/thin strokes, long swashes, interlocking ligatures.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on initial and terminal letters of the script
Heavy dark brown outlines to separate text from the background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid geometric block letters and fluid organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy condensed sans-serif feel
Captures the retro 70s western script vibe

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A centered three-quarter length photograph of a man in a tan suede jacket, cowboy hat, and jeans, looking to the side. The background is a flat horizon at dusk with a gradient from dark brown at the top to bright orange at the horizon, and a black foreground. The lighting is warm and directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two layers of text across the middle. The first is a large, bold, condensed yellow sans-serif name. The second is a retro, orange-toned brush script title that overlaps the first text and the subject's jacket. Both must have thick dark brown outlines and drop shadows.

verificationChecks: Horizon line is straight and low
Typography has a distinct 70s western feel

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the original title

avoid: Bright primary colors like blue or green

postGenerationChecks: Does the text feel integrated into the scene via shadows?
Is the lighting on the subject consistent with the sunset background?
Are the script flourishes smooth and not jagged?
Is the grain uniform across the entire image?
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in Western attire + centered composition + low horizon sunset + dual-style retro typography with thick outlines.
